aus.claim: Issues of procedural fairness are resolved on a case-by-case basis.
aus.limits: The Court is not bound by prior findings of fact where facts differ substantially, such as when an applicant was never formally informed of fraud suspicion.

evidence.quote:
As we know, issues of procedural fairness are resolved on a case-by-case basis, which means that today, the Court is not bound by the findings of fact the Court made on this issue in
Seck 1 first instance
, at paragraphs 17 to 20, especially since the facts differ substantially because the applicant was never formally informed that she was suspected of fraud.

aus.claim: The standard of correctness guides the analysis of the Court with respect to the alleged breach of the rules of procedural fairness.

evidence.quote:
[96]
It is appropriate for the standard of correctness to guide the analysis of the Court with respect to the alleged breach of the rules of procedural fairness:
